label: An OpenBot skill is a named way of doing a task called with /, made in three ways: written, recorded from a demonstration, or proposed from conversations.
Skills share the plugin grant table with MCP but differ in ownership: people create personal skills attachable only to bots they own, administrators create deployment skills.

OpenBot narrows the offered tools by skill: a bot with many tools is offered only the tools of matching skills, and a skill's declaration grants nothing because it is intersected with existing grants.
In-conversation skill authoring suspends the run on a card and writes nothing until the person presses the button; the authoring tools are offered only while the bot holds skill-creator.
A tenant package's skills.yaml turns declared skills into deployment skills on boot, its tools list enables narrowing, and skill-creator is load-bearing for in-conversation authoring.

A Skilled skill is a folder with SKILL.md frontmatter (name, description, allowed-tools, version) plus optional ROUTER.md, references, assets and scripts; routing loads the skill, then the router, then matched leaves.

The spec-kit owns authored spec docs and continuity: numbered packets with spec, plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and implementation summary, strict validation, and one canonical memory-save entrypoint.
A BOT.md body is the standing instruction, and the definition already binds a spec folder and a budget, so bot runs and spec packets are already connected.

Mapping: OpenBot skill is a SKILL.md package, recorded-from-demonstration is a proposed SKILL.md with evidence, tool narrowing is allowed-tools intersected with the bot's declared servers, deployment skills are .skilled/skills, and personal skills are a per-bot section; shared memory belongs in spec-kit continuity, bot-picked facts in a per-bot memory file.

Smallest change is one bots learn command writing a proposed SKILL.md and evidence note into a packet's scratch/proposed-skills, with a review step moving accepted skills into .skilled/skills; no new format is needed.
